title: NSClient V3, AAPS Full, Client1 and Client2; Websockets are disconnected on startup and restart of AAPS 3.3.3.0 -dev b
body:
Websockets are disconnected on startup or restart of App. 

Affected are AAPS Full 3.3.3.0-dev b; AAPS Client 1 3.3.3.0 - dev b; AAPS Client 2 3.3.3.0 - dev b.

Problem results in inability to set TTs, Treatments or profile changes via client.

Rig is:
Blackview N6000, Android 13
Dash
G7 + Diakem APP

Edit:
I observed, that on restart of phones or restart of AAPS (all Versions) Websockets do not connet.
Since AAPSFull restarts ocasionally on itself, this leads to the loss of transmission of data.

comments.body:
Logs of Master (AAPSFull) after restart and no connection to Websockets:

[Log Export.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22468552/Log.Export.txt)

The issue occurs daily. I just got called by a caretaker that her Phone Running AAPSClient got no date. Disonnected Websockets was the issue.
I will rollback to a prior version of AAPS, since this issue is critical in a parental setup.
